packages.name: 2 Hour Dolphin Eco Tour
packages.description: Relaxing cruise into the grand lagoon area along the National Seashore looking for dolphins frolicking in their natural habitat. Cruise into the blue waters of Pensacola Pass and observe the lighthouse. Return through the lagoon to observe the natural beauty of the waterway. Note: Dolphins are wild animals, and there are no guarantees.

packages.name: 2 Hour Dolphin Eco Tour PM
packages.description: Afternoon relaxing cruise into the grand lagoon area along the National Seashore looking for dolphins frolicking in their natural habitat. Cruise into the blue waters of Pensacola Pass and observe the lighthouse. Return through the lagoon to observe the natural beauty of the waterway. Note: Dolphins are wild animals, and there are no guarantees.

packages.name: 3 Hour Dolphin Eco Tour (AM)
packages.description: Morning cruise into the grand lagoon area along the National Seashore looking for dolphins. Tour around Fort Pickens National Park for great photographs of this historic site.

packages.name: 3 Hour Dolphin Eco Tour (PM)
packages.description: Afternoon cruise into the grand lagoon area along the National Seashore looking for dolphins. Tour around Fort Pickens National Park for great photographs of this historic site.

packages.name: 2 Hour Sunset Cruise
packages.description: Relaxing cruise into the intercoastal waterways of Perdido Key Florida and bay areas along the National Seashore where dolphins often cruise and frolic. Return as the sun sets for a romantic and beautiful cruise back to the dock with many photo opportunities of the beautiful sunsets.

packages.name: 3 Hour Blue Angels Practice Shows
packages.description: Unique experience to sit on the intercoastal waterway outside the naval airstrip while watching the world-famous Blue Angel pilots practice their airshow. Cruise up the inter-coastal waterway looking for dolphins in the bays while positioning in the blue waters of the Pensacola pass where you will watch an hour-long flight show as the jets fly over your heads providing many memories and photo opportunities.

packages.name: 4 Hour SandBar Swim/Play (AM)
packages.description: Cruise into the intercoastal waterway of the Pensacola area scouting for dolphins as you head to Fort McCray sand island at the mouth of the Gulf. Beach the boat on the island where you can disembark and spend the day swimming, exploring the rustic fort, and looking for shells along the beautiful beaches.

packages.name: 4 Hour SandBar Swim/Play (PM)
packages.description: Afternoon cruise into the intercoastal waterway of the Pensacola area scouting for dolphins as you head to Fort McCray sand island at the mouth of the Gulf. Beach the boat on the island where you can disembark and spend the day swimming, exploring the rustic fort, and looking for shells along the beautiful beaches.

packages.name: 5 Hour Beach Bar Booze & Lunch
packages.description: Perfect way to enjoy a sunny day with friends while exploring the best local beach bars. Journey begins cruising to Pirates Cove where you can order a 'Cheeseburger in Paradise' and grab a famous bushwhacker topped with 151 while chilling for an hour. Then short cruise to the famous Flora-bama beach bar to drink, swim, and enjoy the beach. Decide to move onto Sunset Grille and/or Hub Stacey's for one final beverage.

packages.name: 7 Hour Beach Bar Cruise
packages.description: Full day exploring the best local beach bars. Journey begins with a stop at Hub Stacey's to grab a beverage or snack. Then off to Pirate's Cove for the famous bushwhacker or 'cheeseburger in Paradise'. Short cruise to stop at Robinson Island for a dip. Then on to the famous Flora-bama beach bar to eat, drink, swim, enjoy the beach, and entertainment before heading back to Port.

packages.name: 3 Hour Bereavement at Sea
packages.description: Small party bereavement trips where the captain escorts you and your loved ones out to the Gulf of America approximately 3 miles to perform a small service of spreading ashes into the waters. We pause at the location for a moment of silence and allow the family to perform a short service and prayer before returning.

packages.name: Full Day Cruising
packages.description: Spend the day on the water cruising either towards Orange or Pensacola beach. Stop to swim at a local sandbar at either location or just cruise into the Bay looking for dolphins. Perhaps prefer to cruise to one of the Beach Restaurants for a lunch and drinks. You book the trip, you set the itinerary, we drive the boat to your desired location between Orange Beach and Pensacola Beach. Please contact us to make arrangements prior to booking this trip.

google_raw_data.name: Tiki & Raw Bar

reviews.text: So I hate to leave really negative reviews but the staff needs to do better also. We stood at the hostess table for 10min before we were told to seat ourselves. Now the live music could have been the issue. We sat outside for the view. We have eaten here before so no biggie. We ordered everything at once cause we had a long wait before our server saw us. We had to flag down another server to replace the sour tea we were given. The food was great, just someone had a bad night. For the sever who we had to flag down, if you had to help us out, why not just keep an eye on us. I don’t care if it’s not your table, we’re paying money, we shouldn’t be penalized cause an employee is having a bad night.

Food and drinks were really good.  Service was good but slow...there seemed to be 1 dedicated person to the outside venue and it was full because of the live music.  The server was doing his best and our orders were always correct...it was busy and live music scheduled....made service slow.  I do recommend visiting and we will be back.

So sad this place is so far removed from other areas, but that may be a contributing factor to it's amazing atmosphere. The service was exemplary. The good was delicious and filling and the bartender actually made my old fashioned as directed AND it was delicious! Lol! Hanging off the Pier this is an open air island paradise that begs for you to enjoy the beautiful weather while you drink and/or eat.
Love this place! The servers Raquel and Abigail were amazing. Great energy and work ethic!! Food and atmosphere are great!
We l8ve this place. Definitely a local favorite

tripadvisor_description: Tiki's Grill & Bar is an ocean-view restaurant overlooking Waikiki Beach. We serve fresh, locally sourced island cuisine with a Pacific Rim flair - from fresh fish & seafood to premium steaks, meats & farm-fresh produce. Our big menu offers something for everyone, with pupus, salads & hearty entrées. Guests enjoy both outdoor & indoor seating for lunch, happy hour, or a romantic sunset dinner. Tropical cocktails in tiki mugs, souvenir glassware & real coconut cups add fun. Choose from local beers, a wine list, and tiki classics like the Lava Flow or the legendary 1944 Mai Tai (debated if Don the Beachcomber or Trader Vic created it). Our craft cocktail bar, The Lava Lounge, offers an elevated experience. From Waikiki's best happy hour to live music with local bands & hula, check our entertainment calendar. Tiki's delivers unforgettable aloha - perfect for families, couples & groups. Locally owned by 3 UH grads with ohana roots in Waikiki for 5+ generations.
